newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed after quiet session.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed after quiet session.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed after an extremely quiet session, and traders said the light volume would make it difficult to read anything into the price action.
"I'm even wondering if we traded one million bushels today. That's how quiet it was," a trader said.

Traders said Wilson bought March wheat at the outset, and had picked up at least 500,000 March by the early midsession. ome guessed that this was tied to commercial short covering. Atwood-Peavey reportedly sold 350,000 May bushels early, then bought back 250,000 later.
MGE spring wheat ended three cents per bushel lower to 1-3/4 cents higher, with March up one cent at $3.87-1/2.
MGE barley did not trade and closed unchanged.
